# Victor Svizev

> Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce Developer with 9+ years of experience in Magento 2 development, based in Dresden, Germany. Independent vendor of commercial Magento 2 extensions on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace under the account VCT.

Victor Svizev works as a Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce Developer at TechDivision GmbH (Germany, remote, since Feb 2023), and independently designs, develops, and sells Magento 2 extensions on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace under the vendor account VCT, with 100+ sales across 4 extensions and 1.5K+ free downloads since 2021. He holds the Adobe Commerce Developer Expert certification (AD0-E725, issued Jun 2026, expires Jun 2028). He is fluent in Russian (native), English, and German (professional working proficiency, telc B2).
